_comment: The comparison step of one iPhone SE 3 review round. See .kit/lib/mobile/roundCompare.mjs.
Q's harness is still on a branch (PR #13, agent/round-phone-gates). This file touches
nothing that PR changes, so it merges with it.
Read this before the first round: as written, the PR #13 harness records no timing and no
frame data at all — no boot measurement, no requestAnimationFrame sampling, no soak block.
It is a pass/fail and screenshot-diff gate only.
Measured, not assumed: pointed at a report of that shape, this comparison passed on the
screenshot diff alone — one metric, and not one of the two the round is actually for. So
the three timing metrics below are marked required, and the round now reports INCOMPARABLE
naming each missing measurement until the harness records them. A red round that says what
is missing beats a green one that measured neither frame time nor load time.
To give Q a comparable round, the harness needs two additions the other three already have:
1. wrap the boot wait in Date.now() and write the elapsed milliseconds to timings.bootMs;
2. sample requestAnimationFrame gaps during a few seconds of automated play and write
Those paths are declared below and start being compared the moment they exist.
Nothing here is evidence about a physical iPhone SE 3.
